## Intent

<!-- State the goal in plain words, list each requested outcome as a short bullet, and say what done looks like for the user. Write fresh public prose; never paste prompts, chat logs or private data. -->

## Problem

<!-- What is wrong or missing, and who it affects. Plain English, no session history. -->

## Fix

<!-- What the change does now, and what it leaves alone. For file structure changes, include one combined folder tree with change markers and short file notes; follow write-pull-request. -->

## Validation

<!-- What was run and what passed. For each test of new or changed behavior, name the user-visible behavior or past bug it guards and the test that failed when its change was reverted in a throwaway copy; a behavior-preserving refactor's tests only need to keep passing. Note any test that failed or was skipped, and why. -->

## Review

<!-- Findings and fixes from the deslop review, and any pending checks. -->
